Natural Language Query: Show me my investors / List all investors / No filter / Show everything
Key Difference in Query: Straight join on corporate_investor and distributor_investor_mapping. No extra WHERE conditions beyond ARN code and name search.

Natural Language Query: Show investors with OTM / Who has mandate / Who has auto debit / OTM registered
Key Difference in Query:
Default query but the inner join on distributor_investor_mapping gets WHERE EXISTS added:
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT FROM sphmf.multiple_bank mb1
WHERE dim1.folio_number=mb1.folio_no AND mb1.om_umrn is NOT null
AND (mb1.cease_dt is null OR CEASE_DT < CURRENT_DATE)
AND mb1.paymech in (select distinct pay_mech from payout_mechanism where otm_flag is true and active_flag is true))
and dim1.arn_code=?

Natural Language Query: Show investors without OTM / Who has no mandate / No auto debit / OTM not registered
Key Difference in Query: Same as OTM Yes but WHERE EXISTS changes to WHERE NOT EXISTS. Excludes folios that have a valid OTM mandate.

Natural Language Query: Show active investors / Who transacted recently / Active in last 6 months
Query to Run: With Active Investor Type Filter query
Key Difference in Query:
Default query but WHERE condition adds:
and (i.uuid in (select distinct map.id from
(select max(date(pd.l_trxn_date)) as date, dim.investor_uuid id
from sphmf.customer_schemes pd INNER JOIN distributor_investor_mapping dim
on pd.folio_no=dim.folio_number where arn_code=? group by dim.investor_uuid) map
where CURRENT_DATE - date <= 180))

Natural Language Query: Show dormant investors / Who hasn't transacted / Inactive investors / No recent activity
Query to Run: With Dormant Investor Type Filter query
Key Difference in Query: Same as Active but condition changes to CURRENT_DATE - date >= 180

Natural Language Query: Show CGF investors / Who holds CGF schemes / CGF only
Key Difference in Query:
Default query but WHERE condition adds:
and (i.uuid in (select distinct dim.investor_uuid id from sphmf.customer_schemes pd
inner join distributor_investor_mapping dim on dim.folio_number=pd.folio_no
where arn_code=? and (pd.sch_code in
(select schcode from sphmf.scheme_setup where cgf_flag='C' and plan_type<>'D'))))

Natural Language Query: Show minor investors / Investors who are minors / Minor accounts only
Key Difference in Query:
Default query but joins sphmf.customer_master cm on cm.folio_no=dim.folio_number and WHERE adds:
and ((cm.inv_type='02' or cm.inv_type='26'))

Natural Language Query: Show CGF and minor investors / Investors who are CGF or minor / Both CGF and minor selected
Query to Run: With Minor and CGF Investor Sub-Type query
Key Difference in Query:
Combines CGF and Minor conditions using OR:
WHERE (CGF scheme check) OR (cm.inv_type='02' or cm.inv_type='26')

Natural Language Query: Show others / Non CGF non minor investors / Investors not in CGF or minor
Query to Run: With Others Investor Subtype Filter query
Key Difference in Query:
Default query but WHERE adds both exclusions:
and (investor NOT IN CGF schemes) AND (NOT (cm.inv_type='02' or cm.inv_type='26'))

Natural Language Query: Show active investors with OTM / Active investors who have mandate
Filter Being Applied: Investor Type = Active + OTM = Yes (combination - run both separately)
Query to Run: Run Active query first, then apply OTM Yes filter on result
Key Difference in Query: No single combined query exists in the document for this. Active query handles the 180 day check. OTM Yes query handles the mandate check. Run both and intersect results.

Natural Language Query: Show dormant investors with no OTM / Inactive investors without mandate
Filter Being Applied: Investor Type = Dormant + OTM = No (combination - run both separately)
Query to Run: Run Dormant query first, then apply OTM No filter on result
Key Difference in Query: No single combined query in document. Dormant query checks last transaction >= 180 days. OTM No query checks WHERE NOT EXISTS on multiple_bank. Run both and intersect.

Natural Language Query: Show CGF investors who are active / Active CGF investors
Filter Being Applied: Investor Type = Active + Sub Type = CGF (combination - run both separately)
Query to Run: Run CGF query first, then apply Active filter on result
Key Difference in Query: No single combined query in document. CGF query checks scheme_setup for cgf_flag = C. Active query checks last transaction within 180 days. Run both and intersect.

Natural Language Query: Show minor investors with OTM / Minor investors who have mandate
Filter Being Applied: Sub Type = Minor + OTM = Yes (combination - run both separately)
Query to Run: Run Minor query first, then apply OTM Yes filter on result
Key Difference in Query: No single combined query in document for this combination. Minor query checks inv_type 02 or 26. OTM Yes query checks multiple_bank. Run both and intersect results.
